title: ShiftyBusiness
description: Introducing the new Shifter Block, to simplify work
body:
Shifty Business adds a couple new blocks that garentee loot. 
The idea stemed from the goal to garentee that Gravel drops Flint when you craft it into a "Gravel Filled Shifter" then simply right click onto the block to drop the shifter block and the flint. 

The mod then extends this concept to Sand, Red Sand, Clay, Mud, Soul Sand, and Soul Soul. 
The Shifter block is crafted by forming sticks into an X shape, then the rest of the blocks are shapeless recipes with 1 Shifter block and 1 Gravel/Sand/Clay/Etc...
